title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat OpenStack Services on OpenShift 18.0 (python-botocore) security update
description:
A low-level interface to a growing number of Amazon Web Services. The
botocore package is the foundation for the AWS CLI as well as boto3.

Security Fix(es):

* python-botocore: Distrust eMudhra intermediate CA certificates due to
security concerns (CVE-2026-114406)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS
score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE
page listed in the References section.
